input.quote: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman. If Sparkling terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 17(b), Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
input.rationale: Section 17 addresses only Sparkling's obligation to cease use and return/destroy Garman's Software, Documentation and Codes; there is no exit-assistance obligation and no requirement for Garman to return our data (including data converted under Section 4(b)) or to delete and certify deletion. Section 14 imposes only confidentiality obligations, and Section 18 survival lists nothing on transition or data return. Searches for "transition" and "data" confirm the absence. Inserted a new Section 17(d) matching the preferred position: six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and subsequent deletion with written certification.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 17(d) requiring Garman to provide transition assistance, return Sparkling's data in machine-readable form within 30 days, and certify deletion.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause at Section 17(d): on any expiry or termination Garman provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and then deletes it and certifies deletion. The Agreement currently obliges only Sparkling to return/destroy materials on termination (Section 17(b)) and is silent on the return of our converted data under Section 4(b), which leaves us unable to migrate; we can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback.

ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (1) at Sparkling's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (2) within thirty (30) calendar days of such expiry or termination, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data in Garman's possession or control, including all data converted pursuant to Section 4(b), in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (3) thereafter delete all such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing.
